# Hypercube UI

> Screen components in CSS on tokens plus Web Components, for any stack (plain HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Blazor, Astro, server-rendered). No framework, no build. Light and dark, built for phones (360 px).

To apply it to an existing app, read AGENTS.md first: the steps, the "what to swap for what" table, the design rules, phones, accessibility and the checklist.

## Read in this order

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the how-to (required)
- [AUDIT.md](AUDIT.md): the adherence checklist; `scripts/audit.mjs` and `audit/audit.js` run its automatic part
- [components.json](components.json): every piece with its classes, when to use it and the exact markup
- [recipes/](recipes/): install and markup per stack
- [catalog/pages/](catalog/pages/): piece examples and whole-screen templates (`template-*.html`; the ones that move have a script in `catalog/js/`)

## Library files

- [src/index.css](src/index.css): import only this one
- [src/tokens.css](src/tokens.css): colour, space, type, radius, motion
- [src/components.css](src/components.css): button, field, tabs, badge, avatar, panel, stats, loader
- [src/states.css](src/states.css): empty, loading, error, alert
- [src/overlays.css](src/overlays.css): modal, drawer, menu, toast
- [src/layout.css](src/layout.css): sidebar, context switcher (workspace, organisation, product), top bar, page
- [src/screens.css](src/screens.css): list + detail, chat, settings, sign in, table
- [src/boards.css](src/boards.css): connected tree, node, canvas, flow editor, week calendar, usage timeline, diff
- [src/hc.css](src/hc.css): pieces for screens where AI works (trail, question, needs you…)
- [src/elements.js](src/elements.js): <hc-ask>, <hc-sheet>, long press
